# beenfar_switch_port (Resource)

Settings of one port of an adopted switch. A port with no settings runs with the device's defaults; destroying this resource returns the port to them.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are managed: the others are neither changed by Terraform nor reported as drift, so they can be managed in the beenfar UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Port 8 is a trunk to an access point: the default network untagged, and
# only the iot and guest VLANs tagged. PoE powers the access point.
resource "beenfar_switch_port" "ap_uplink" {
  device_id          = beenfar_device.core_switch.id
  port_index         = 8
  name               = "AP uplink"
  tagging            = "custom"
  tagged_network_ids = [beenfar_network.iot.id, beenfar_network.guest.id]
  poe_mode           = "auto"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) Id of the adopted device, e.g. `beenfar_device.x.id`.
- `port_index` (Number) 1-based port number, as printed on the device.

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) Turn the port off.
- `name` (String) Port label, at most 64 bytes.
- `native_network_id` (String) Id of the `beenfar_network` carried untagged; empty for the default network.
- `poe_mode` (String) Power over Ethernet: `auto` (the controller's default) or `off`.
- `tagged_network_ids` (Set of String) Ids of the networks carried tagged, with `tagging = "custom"`.
- `tagging` (String) Networks carried tagged: `all` (the controller's default), `none`, or `custom` for those in `tagged_network_ids`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier. Import uses it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id.
terraform import beenfar_switch_port.example <id>
```
